description:
[Protocol Health Oracle] Latest health score for one protocol: components (GitHub activity, TVL trend, treasury), source details, and score history.

Use when you are vetting one protocol before integrating it and want GitHub activity, TVL trend and treasury components. Not for a ranking (use protocol_health_scoreboard) or token contract risk (use token_risk).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

history.description: Optional. Number of historical scores to include (default 10, max 100).

slug.description: Required (path). The protocol's defillama_slug, e.g. lido.

name: protocol_health_score
